title: Removability criterion for radiative corrections to the Starobinsky attractor in weakly nonlocal gravity
summary: Radiative corrections at the percent level can shift the predictions of $α$-attractor and Starobinsky-like models into the region of the $(n_s,r)$ plane preferred by ACT DR6. We show that the decisive property is not the size of a correction but whether it is removable. In the slow-roll $N$-formalism the observables are functionals of $\eps(N)$, and equality of $\eps(N)$ on an interval reconstructs the potential up to an amplitude rescaling and a shift of the canonical field.
